title: Best Leather Gloves 2026: 5 pairs tested at 28°F for warmth and touchscreen
description: Hestra, Mujjo, Dents, Coach, UGG — 60 days of winter wear. Warmth in finger temps, touchscreen response rate, cashmere vs shearling vs unlined.
lede: Five leather gloves. 60 days of winter commute. We taped a thermometer to a finger and timed iPhone unlocks through each glove at 28°F.
methodology: Same 28°F (-2°C) morning, 20-min walks. Skin-temp probe taped to index finger. Face-ID unlock timed through fingertip. Day 1, 30, 60 evaluation.

sections.heading: Warmth and touchscreen
paragraphs: UGG shearling: 1.5°F finger drop (warmest). Dents cashmere: 2.2°F. Hestra: 2.5°F. Coach: 3.0°F. Mujjo nappa: 4.5°F (thinnest, touchscreen-optimized).
Touchscreen success: Mujjo 12/12, Coach 11/12, UGG 9/12, Dents 7/12, Hestra 5/12. Mujjo for daily phone use, UGG/Dents for warmth, Hestra for dress.

faqs.q: Cashmere vs shearling — which is warmer?
faqs.a: Shearling (UGG) is warmer at -5°F to 20°F. Cashmere (Hestra, Dents, Coach) is warmer at 25-45°F. Below -10°F, switch to mittens.

faqs.q: How to care for leather gloves?
faqs.a: Brush with horsehair after wet days. Condition with leather cream (Saphir) every 6 months. Stuff with cedar shoe trees. Avoid radiator drying.

hestra-elegance-hairsheep.review: Best dress glove. Hand-stitched Swedish heritage at $155-210. Hairsheep is supple, cashmere keeps fingers warm for 25-45°F.

mujjo-touchscreen-leather.review: Best touchscreen. Conductive thread in all 10 fingers = 100% Face-ID success. Sacrifices warmth (4.5°F drop) for usability.

dents-bath-cashmere-lined.review: English heritage since 1777. 100% cashmere lining among warmest (2.2°F drop). Hairsheep is buttery.

coach-tech-cashmere-gloves.review: Department-store mainstay. Lambskin with cashmere, touchscreen tips. 11/12 swipe success.

ugg-shearling-cuff-gloves.review: Warmest in test. Sheepskin lining means just 1.5°F drop at 28°F. Best for under 20°F.
